entity.label: Legal entity and governance structure
entity.status: OPEN / NOT FIXED BY CURRENT AUTHORITY
entity.statement: The current planning authority establishes 2026 as a legal/IP structuring period but does not fix final entity formation details, founder/equity structure or governance instruments.
entity.next_gate: Record a separate controlled founder/legal decision for entity, governance and equity details when ready; keep restricted instruments outside the public repository.

governance.label: Public repository governance posture
governance.statement: Repository visibility is public, while licensing, contribution provenance and reviewer ownership are not yet established by a controlled founder/legal decision.
governance.next_gate: Resolve G-REPO-IP-POLICY with an explicit reviewed repository visibility, licensing, contribution and ownership policy.

rights_gates.label: Code, contributor and brand-asset provenance
rights_gates.statement: Repository history and asset presence do not establish complete chain of title. The controlled provenance intake remains open and must preserve unresolved contributor, baseline-origin and brand-asset gaps.
rights_gates.next_gate: Complete the controlled provenance register and reviewed disposition without committing sensitive agreements, signatures, identity records or private prompt transcripts.

rights_gates.label: Third-party data and service rights
rights_gates.statement: Third-party source confirmation is not product-use authorization. Item-level rights, attribution, service authority and release disposition remain open, with explicit HOLD states where the source gate requires them.
rights_gates.next_gate: Advance DATA-LIC-G1 through G8 with exact receipts, runtime-use classification, attribution evidence and a dated reviewed disposition.

rights_gates.label: Repository IP, licence and contribution policy
rights_gates.statement: A public repository is not automatically open source. No licence, CLA, DCO or contribution-ownership posture is selected by this projection.
rights_gates.next_gate: Record and implement the reviewed repository licensing, contribution provenance and reviewer-ownership decision without granting rights to externally controlled material.

confidentiality.safe_projection_rule: Store only public-safe state, gate status and controlled references. Restricted evidence remains in its controlled source system.
